div.div:
1. Package duplication: - Before npm v3, dependencies were installed exactly according to the dependency graph, which makes deeply nested node_moduels
Duplicaiton problem
A single folder have tens of thousands of files would make the filesystem lookups slower, also window often hit max_path limit for nested folders

div.div: packages with install/postinstall scripts (native binary builds, like sharp which compiles/downloads image processing binaries, or unrs-resolver which has a native Rust resolver binary) are blocked from running their build scripts by default. This is a supply-chain security measure — a malicious package could otherwise run arbitrary code at install time via postinstall.
